notes: Normalized from a noisy capture. Color: greyscale-on-#010101 with chapter grounds (#8e9291 grey, #505544 olive, #f1f0ea off-white); two rationed accents — chartreuse #dff140 (edge/glow/'active') and electric blue #0000ee (links; possibly an unstyled-default smell, kept as link role). Type scale rounded from observed 12/14/16/18/24/32/40/64px; the large Times New Roman count in the raw profile is treated as fallback / unstyled CMS DOM (the capture also caught unrendered template tokens like @[title]) and excluded from families' visible roles — visible type is HelveticaNowDisplay with Elios as a sparing display face. Signature is the tracking: +0.48px on 12px caps, going negative as size grows. Single shadow is the chartreuse glow; everything else is flat. 2px radius is global; 100px is the pill on a couple of controls. Motion: Lenis inertial scroll + IntersectionObserver in-view reveals (inView keyframe, 88 IO targets, rootMargin 250px) + animated link underline (linkbutton-underline-in/-replay) + a pinned hero canvas/video with wordmark parallax. prefers-reduced-motion is NOT respected.
